verdict.rationale: Polar's Checkout Links feature is explicitly documented as no-code: 'Configure once in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere... Polar handles the rest,' matching the founder story of generating a shareable payment link without engineering work, and the sandbox/test-card flow lets a founder validate selling before going live. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the dashboard link-creation UX and time-to-first-sale beyond vendor docs.
